scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:stories && npm run build
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData -packageAuthorizationProvider netrc CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
